name: Gosaikunda sacred lakes
why: A steep climb through forest and the Laurebina ridge to a group of high lakes holy to Shiva, with the Langtang and Ganesh ranges behind you.
book: Langtang National Park permit and TIMS card. Since April 2023 Nepal requires foreign trekkers to hire a licensed guide in its national parks and conservation areas (check the current rule before you go). Bus or jeep from Kathmandu to Dhunche (6-7 h). In August, thousands of pilgrims come for Janai Purnima.
water: Lodges at Chandanbari, Laurebina and the lake.
dangers: From Dhunche to the lake you climb 2,400 m: sleep at Chandanbari and Laurebina.
Snow and ice on the ridge from December to March.
turnaround: If you are not at Laurebina by 15:00, sleep there.

points.name: Dhunche
points.note: The district town and the gate of Langtang National Park.

points.name: Chandanbari
points.note: Sing Gompa monastery and a cheese factory in fir forest.

points.name: Laurebina
points.note: A ridge-top stop at 3,900 m: the Ganesh Himal and Langtang range in a row.

points.name: Gosaikunda
points.note: A dark blue lake at 4,380 m with a small Shiva shrine on its shore.
